note: flags from an independent visual reviewer who looked at the compare images

flags.problem: Light/white fringe along the inside edges of the black NYPD letters at 1:1 (and faintly in the shrunk panel); the original has only a soft magenta glow there. Introduced by the per-channel ink back-projection, so the halo is not in the source.
flags.fix: Rebuild the ink from the original's glow colour instead of back-projection, or keep the hard cutout alpha and clamp the ink to the letter interior. Confirm the letter edge is black-to-transparent with no lighter ring, then re-run the gate.
